description: Two consecutive matrix multiplications: D = alpha*A*B + beta*D, then E = alpha*C*D + beta*E for NxN single-precision matrices. Emits per-pass kernel times; compute throughput (GFLOPS) is derived downstream.

non_scaling_params.name: alpha
non_scaling_params.description: Scaling factor alpha for matrix multiply

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of untimed warmup passes before timing (boosts the clock; with vector_add_warmup on these run the warmer instead of the real kernel).

non_scaling_params.name: iteration
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations, each recorded individually; the summary total is their sum. Take the min downstream for the least-perturbed sample.
